limitations: Newly generated model with new hashes and new validation. Historical batch-04 reviews are not acceptance of these artifacts.
No physical fit, material calibration, complete hidden layout, original application compatibility or hardware acceptance is implied.
USB shell is physically open in the mesh but contact tongues, detailed contacts and mating dimensions remain unknown. Source-photo parallax does not measure connector height.
Header count/centers are source-backed; body and pin dimensions including hidden insertion length remain unmeasured estimates. No physical mating guarantee.
No exact N8R8 native CAD was located in inspected official pages. Original FH4R2 Zero CAD topology and silkscreen are not copied.
N8R8 package is shown at a source-backed approximate 45-degree angle. Exact package edge, height, PCB stackup, bottom contact layout and hidden small passives remain UNKNOWN.
Small pads, solder fillets and printed labels are not reconstructed from the low-resolution oblique photographs. No arbitrary detailed circuit placement is fabricated.

exactVariant.basis: Manual board-edge registration on the unchanged official 420 × 360 N8R8-M photograph. Some corner regions are obscured by USB and soldered pins, so anchors include visible-edge extrapolation; they are not precise directly measured corners. No pixel-level error bound or dimensional fit is claimed.
exactVariant.scope: Manual board-plane comparison only. Component-top parallax, height, hidden faces and material/fit precision are not calibrated.
